description:
Cast Marina Vendrell's Grimoire by paying {5}{U}.
When Marina Vendrell's Grimoire enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw five cards.
Horizon Chimera triggers five times.
Resolve the first Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 5.
